name: Tyrannosaurus
description: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

abilities.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

abilities.name: Crushing Bite
abilities.description: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.
